name: Landys
testimony: The 2025 CAN-CWiC not only inspired me with new topics in computing, AI, and ML, but also enhanced my own understanding in these fields causing more motivation to begin innovation and increase advancements in the industry. This would not have been possible without the support from sponsors that made my attendance possible, and due to this support, they have just caused a ripple effect of positive impact that will continue for years to come as I turn this motivation into projects, research opportunities, and solutions for problems within our local communities.

name: Guneet
testimony: CAN-CWiC was an incredibly empowering experience that reminded me of the strength and support within the women-in-tech community. I left feeling inspired, confident, and motivated to keep creating inclusive spaces where others can thrive too.

name: Emily
testimony: Attending CAN-CWiC 2025 was a transformative experience that strengthened my confidence and sense of belonging in tech. I’m incredibly grateful for the support that made this opportunity possible.

name: Ipsa
testimony: Getting to attend such an amazing conference like CAN-CWiC made me realize that diversity isn’t just about numbers - it is about building a culture where everyone feels safe to share ideas and where our differences become our strengths. It was so nice and encouraging to meet such incredible women in STEM, who continue to break barriers, uplift others, and redefine what it means to belong in tech. Listening to their journeys reminded me that success in this field isn’t about fitting in, it’s about standing out with courage, empathy and authenticity.

name: Myla
testimony: This conference helped me clarify my career aspirations and gave me new motivation to pursue work grounded in impact, empathy, and innovation. It also strengthened my belief in the importance of diversity in tech, as diverse voices lead to better, more inclusive solutions. I hope to bring back what I have learned from the conference to the communities I teach and work in.

name: Saachi
testimony: After attending this conference, I genuinely feel like an improved version of myself. I learned so much through the talks, panel discussions, and conversations with industry professionals and fellow attendees. I also made meaningful connections that I believe will support me as I continue navigating my journey in tech. Overall, this experience strengthened my sense of belonging in the tech community, and I’m incredibly grateful for everything Ada’s Team did to make it possible.

name: Aara
testimony: I am deeply grateful for the incredible opportunity to attend conferences. These experiences have pushed me out of my comfort zone, helped me grow my connections, and empowered me to build a strong community. They have played a meaningful role in shaping my goals and the confidence to pursue them.

name: Heer
testimony: As an international student and woman in tech, this conference made me feel seen, supported, and inspired. It showed me that I belong here, and that my goals are possible.

name: Harshita
testimony: Leaving the conference, I felt energized and connected, like I’d found a community. I met people I can’t wait to collaborate with, mentors I admire, and friends who understand the journey I’m on. It reminded me why diversity in tech matters, because we need all voices and backgrounds to build a better future.

name: Aafiya
testimony: CAN-CWiC helped me grow my confidence, expand my network, and feel more connected to the tech community through wonderful new opportunities and friendships. I’m truly grateful to the donors who make opportunities like this possible for students like me.

name: Rav
testimony: Going to CAN-CWiC was a truly inspiring and empowering experience for me. Some of my favourite moments were connecting with other attendees, hearing about their personal journeys, and meeting so many incredible women and leaders of the tech industry. Being surrounded by people who understood my goals, challenges, and aspirations made me feel supported, motivated, and reminded me that I genuinely belong in this space.

name: Samia
testimony: This conference helped me realize that I am not alone in my journey. I met many women who share similar goals, and I built meaningful relationships with both students and professionals. It strengthened my connection to the tech community and inspired me to keep uplifting others as I continue growing in this field.

name: Judy
testimony: Attending CAN-CWiC 2025 was one of the most inspiring experiences I’ve had this year. Beyond the technical learnings, I also took away from the conference a clearer picture of the skills needed to succeed in this field: to always keep learning, embrace new opportunities, build meaningful connections, and support others in this community.
